'''Riknak''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Prima" /> [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|131|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: An Audience of Aliens}}</ref> affiliated with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Prima" /> He was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]],<ref name="Prima" /> but had been off-world<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} and ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he visited the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and viewed that year's [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] from the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]].<ref name="TPM" /> Riknak stood with the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] aspiring [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[LobwuWa Loba]]<ref name="Insider" /> in the [[Watto's box/Legends|viewing box]] of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="TPM" />

By some point shortly later in 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bounty, originating from [[Hurleydo Travels]], had been issued for the Weequay's [[Death/Legends|death]]. It stated that Riknak, whose last known location was [[Imperial Station Bravo|Gardulla's palace]], had hijacked the company's tourist [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and took the occupants in them with him.<ref name="Prima" />

==Behind the scenes==
Riknak appeared in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''. He is the final secondary bounty of the level ''Gardulla's Palace'' (and the final secondary bounty in the entire game overall). In [[2012]], the incarnation of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''{{'s}} [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] from [[Star Wars Insider 131|Issue 131]], "An Audience of Aliens," identified individuals in Watto's viewing box from the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] film ([[1999]]). The article [[Retroactive continuity|established retroactively]] that Riknak was among them.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|131|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: An Audience of Aliens}}</ref>
